page.layout: One printed page, title page, centred lines; a woodcut ornament of two putti with a wreath below the text; no margin text. Handwritten marks and a library stamp/shelf mark are not transcribed.

main_text.l: In illustri illustrissimorum Dominorum Bernatum Athenaeo Professoris dignissimi, Praeceptoris sui quovis honore ac amore nunquam non prosequendi.
Ad diem 18. Aprilis horis locoque solitis.

page.notes: The Greek line "Θεῶ Τελεσϐελτίςῳ συμφράτλου" is set in a Greek-style type and may contain printing irregularities; copied as it appears. Handwritten "A-3'949'014" shelf mark and the digitiser's watermark text, and the handwritten "I" at upper right, are omitted. Woodcut ornament of two putti holding a laurel wreath is described here, not transcribed.
